cohort: Pregnant participants aged >=18 years, enrolled at 24-32 weeks' gestation in the HAPO FUS, without prepregnancy hypertension or diabetes, were included.
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (GDM and HDP) mediated a small proportion of the association between prepregnancy obesity and mid-life cardiovascular disease risk factors (MAP, triglycerides, and HbA1c).
